widgetInfo:
<LinearLayout
  width="@data{width}"
  height="match_content"
  orientation="vertical"
  cornerRadius="8np"
  backgroundColor="@dtDarkModeAdapter{'#ffffff','#1E1E1E'}">
  <LinearLayout
    width="match_parent"
    height="match_content"
    orientation="vertical"
    paddingLeft="12np"
    paddingRight="12np"
    paddingTop="10np"
    paddingBottom="10np"
    visibility="@triple{@equal{@toStr{@data{data.cardData.flowStatus}},@toStr{1}},'visible','gone'}">
    <FastTextView
      width="match_parent"
      height="match_content"
      text="Siclaw is thinking..."
      textSize="14np"
      textColor="@dtDarkModeAdapter{'#83898F','#A5A5A6'}" />
  </LinearLayout>
  <LinearLayout
    width="match_parent"
    height="match_content"
    orientation="vertical"
    paddingLeft="12np"
    paddingRight="12np"
    paddingTop="6np"
    paddingBottom="6np"
    visibility="@triple{@equal{@toStr{@data{data.cardData.flowStatus}},@toStr{2}},'visible','gone'}">
    <DDRichTextView
      width="match_parent"
      height="match_content"
      attributedText="@data{data.cardData.content}" />
  </LinearLayout>
  <LinearLayout
    width="match_parent"
    height="match_content"
    orientation="vertical"
    paddingLeft="12np"
    paddingRight="12np"
    paddingTop="6np"
    paddingBottom="6np"
    visibility="@triple{@equal{@toStr{@data{data.cardData.flowStatus}},@toStr{3}},'visible','gone'}">
    <DDRichTextView
      width="match_parent"
      height="match_content"
      attributedText="@data{data.cardData.content}" />
  </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
